fact: Farede has injectors with capacity of 80 up to 380 tons of closing, vertical and two-color injection — stated on both their English services page (farede.com.br/eng/servicos.html) and their equipment/structure page (farede.com.br/eng/estrutura.html), confirmed live as of July 2026.
Farede is an official licensee of the sports brands Topper, Rainha, and SpoArt, as stated on their official Facebook page and services page (farede.com.br/eng/servicos.html).

Farede Injetados Plásticos e Ferramentaria Ltda was founded on 22 March 1994 (CNPJ 74.547.514/0001-06), is currently ATIVA (active) per Brazilian federal registry, and is headquartered at Rua Ulisses Cruz, 921 – Tatuapé, São Paulo – SP, CEP 03077-000. The company's own live website (farede.com.br) confirms it 'atua desde 1994' and lists the same Tatuapé address. The 11–50 employee band is the figure reported by ZoomInfo/Crunchbase; no contradicting headcount data was found. As of July 2026, the company has been in continuous operation for 32+ years.

Farede (full legal name: Farede Injetados Plásticos e Ferramentaria Ltda) is a plastic injection mold manufacturer based in Tatuapé, São Paulo, specializing in the segments of footwear (calçadista), orthopedic, sports/extreme sports (esportivo/esportes radicais), civil construction (construção civil), toys (brinquedos), and motorcyclist accessories (acessórios para motociclistas). This breadth is confirmed across its own live website pages, its corporate registration (contrato social) as cited in a 2022 Jusbrasil labor court filing, and a current BounceWatch company profile.
